div.head: Abt 4
div.ab: Gif frigman cyninge stele, IXgylde forgylde.
Gif frigman cyninge stele, IX gylde forgylde.
Gif frigman cyninge stele, IX gylde forgylde.
Wenn ein Freier dem Könige [etwas] stiehlt, vergelte er [es ihm] 9fach.
If a freeman steals [something] from the king, let him repay [it to him] 9-fold.
If a freeman robs the king, he shall pay back a nine fold amount.
If a freeman steal from the king, he is to repay nine-fold.
If a freeman should steal from the king, let him compensate with 9[-fold] compensation.

note.label: as in
note.quote: Grið 6 – 8 equates the mundbyrd of king, archbishop and 'Christ's church' on Cantwara lage as in Wi 2, and rehearses the ... multiples as in Abt 1, 4

note.seg: Den Satz oder seinen Inhalt benutzt Grið 7. — ‘Irgend ein Volksgenoss’ auch u. 9; s. Wb freo 1; frigman 3. Auf dem Stande liegt nur insofern Nachdruck, als der Unfreie ausgeschlossen wird; dessen Diebstahl behandelt u. c. 90 gesondert; dagegen soll nicht etwa der adlige Voll(Über)freie oder der wirtschaftlich Abhängige ausgeschlossen sein; so übersetzt den allgemeinen hominem durch frionne Af El 15; ebenso in Dichtung Genesis 2746. 2754

Grið 7 uses this clause or its content. — ‘Any member of the people’ also below 9; see Wb freo 1; frigman 3. Rank is emphasised only insofar as the unfree man is excluded; his theft is dealt with separately below c. 90; on the other hand, the fully free (‘over-free’) noble or the economically dependent man is by no means meant to be excluded; thus Af El 15 renders the general hominem by frionne; likewise, in poetry, Genesis 2746. 2754
Der Diebstahl ist wieder (s. o. 1⁴) nicht handhaft
Again (see above 1⁴) the theft is not one caught in the act
Königs Fahrnis steht also der des Priesters gleich; s. o. 1⁷
The king’s movable goods thus rank equal with the priest’s; see above 1⁷
It is remarkable that the compensation due to the king is less than that due to a bishop (cf. cap. 1).
